# CleanUp SKG

> Professional cleaning services in Thessaloniki, Greece — homes, offices, post-construction, bio-cleaning, steam disinfection, pressure washing, and window cleaning. Multilingual (Greek, English, Russian).

CleanUp SKG (cleanupskg.gr) is a Thessaloniki-based cleaning company offering reliable, eco-friendly cleaning for residential and commercial spaces across Kalamaria, Thermi, Pylaia, Panorama, Evosmos, Stavroupoli, and Neapoli. Contact: info@cleanupskg.gr, +30 697 477 6057.
